purpose: Durable evidence for the C4 full-suite verification requirement: the canonical environment has PRE-EXISTING local collection errors and environment-dependent failures, so C4 verification uses exact failure-set equivalence between the canonical parent tree and the C4 candidate tree under equivalent conditions, with HEAD_NEW_FULL_SUITE_FAILURES = 0.

conditions.method: Two identical full-suite runs on the same machine, same venv, same pytest flags: python -m pytest -q --continue-on-collection-errors
conditions.baseline_tree: git worktree state at canonical parent 789e199b373ccd1b7a4e3c6df1fc55989f1c466d (branch c4-python-tooling-normalization-v0 checked out at the canonical SHA, before candidate content was added)
conditions.candidate_tree: same worktree after pyproject.toml + C4 registration/artifacts/tests
conditions.raw_outputs: /tmp/qntylab_c4_baseline_full.txt (baseline run, matches receipt baseline exactly) and /tmp/qntylab_c4_candidate_full2.txt (real final candidate run, matches receipt candidate exactly). Correction F2: the originally referenced /tmp/qntylab_c4_candidate_full.txt actually holds the disclosed DISCARDED intermediate run (204F/3477P/0 skipped), not the final run. /tmp files are ephemeral; the receipt's recorded counts and failure-set accounting are the durable record.

documented_run_mode: python -m pytest -q (README.md:65) cannot complete on this local environment: collection is interrupted by the 4 pre-existing environment collection errors (3x ModuleNotFoundError polars, 1x ModuleNotFoundError retry) both before and after C4; --continue-on-collection-errors is therefore required for any full-suite comparison, exactly as in the C3 full-suite verification receipt.

baseline_full_suite.note: Baseline failure set was reproduced deterministically across two independent baseline runs (identical counts: 89 failed / 3585 passed / 2 skipped / 15 errors). Includes the documented pre-existing failure tests/test_qntylab_repository_ergonomics_and_modularity_cleanup_decision_v0.py::test_c1_not_started. The baseline runs executed on a CLEAN worktree at exactly the canonical parent SHA 789e199b373ccd1b7a4e3c6df1fc55989f1c466d.

candidate_full_suite.note: 3585 baseline passes + 5 new C4 contract tests (tests/test_qntylab_python_tooling_normalization_v0.py) all passing; zero new failures (HEAD_NEW_FAILURES = 0, HEAD_NEW_ERRORS = 0).

resolved_pre_existing_failures.cause: Worktree-cleanliness artifact of the execution-authority identity projection, NOT a C4 content effect. qntylab/project_context_execution_authority.py _canonical_activation_identity computes effective = (worktree clean AND HEAD == refs/remotes/origin/master AND candidate_base_is_ancestor). The baseline runs executed on a CLEAN checkout exactly at origin/master (789e199b), so six fail-closed DSH execution-identity tests assert effective == False and fail there. The candidate runs executed with the uncommitted C4 candidate content in the worktree (dirty), so effective == False and those six tests pass.
resolved_pre_existing_failures.controlled_evidence: In a pristine separate worktree at 789e199b (clean), two of the six tests fail; adding a single UNTRACKED probe file to that same pristine worktree (no C4 content present) flips them to pass. The six tests are therefore sensitive to worktree cleanliness, not to C4 content.
resolved_pre_existing_failures.post_commit_expectation: After the C4 candidate is committed, local HEAD != refs/remotes/origin/master, so effective == False and all six tests remain passing; the resolution persists at the committed PR head and in CI.

equivalence.failure_set_relation: candidate FAILED set == baseline FAILED set minus exactly the 6 worktree-cleanliness-dependent pre-existing failures listed above (verified by grep '^FAILED' list diff: 0 new, 6 resolved, resolved-set cause independently controlled).

notes: The 15 errors include the 4 pre-existing collection errors plus 11 pre-existing setup errors (e.g. tests/test_curated_breadth_summary.py fixture errors) present identically on both trees. A prior intermediate candidate run (204 failed / 3477 passed / 0 skipped) was executed BEFORE the C4 artifacts were complete; its excess failures (115) were caused by python -m qntylab.project_context brief/doctor failing closed on the then-missing full_suite_verification_receipt.json referenced by the C4 registration row, and are not part of the final candidate result recorded here. C4 adds zero runtime surface.
